enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Shift legs. Snore lightly. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply face wash. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl. Crack eggs. Add milk. Whisk. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour mixture. Cook. Stir. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat with fork. Drink milk. Stand up. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in work uniform and packing items for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out uniform. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Open drawer. Take out stethoscope. Place in bag. Clip ID badge. Open backpack. Place water bottle. Place notebook. Zip backpack. Pick up backpack. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Get in. Put on seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust mirrors. Shift gear. Release brake. Drive. Stop at red light. Continue. Turn right. Park. Turn off engine. Unbuckle seatbelt. Get out. Lock car. Walk to hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the hospital, providing patient care and reviewing charts
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on stethoscope. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up patient chart. Read chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Auscultate heart. Auscultate lungs. Palpate abdomen. Ask questions. Record notes. Walk to next patient room. Repeat.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay cashier. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Carry tray to return area. Place tray on rack. Walk to restroom. Use restroom. Wash hands. Dry hands. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties and patient care at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Administer medication. Insert IV. Monitor vital signs. Assist with procedures. Consult with doctors. Update records. Walk to patient room. Check patient status. Adjust IV drip. Respond to call light. Talk to patient. Document notes. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to nurses' station. Review lab results. Call lab. Walk to patient room. Discharge patient.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Get in. Put on seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust mirrors. Shift gear. Release brake. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue. Turn left. Park. Turn off engine. Unbuckle seatbelt. Get out. Lock car. Walk to door. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on cutting board. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Cut chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Lift fork to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Repeat. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back. Sit on sofa. Open snack. Eat snack. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing on the phone before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open app. Scroll. Tap. Read. Type message. Send message. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Lie down.
Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to other side. Pull blanket. Shift legs. Snore. Remain asleep.
